name: Ultralight White Oak Slats, Grey Felt
summary: White oak real wood veneer laminated onto 9 mm recycled grey acoustic felt, with no MDF or other rigid core.

texture.note: Spec-sheet dimensions override photo estimates: seven 1.20 in oak faces with 0.49 in, 90-degree V-grooves (6.2 mm deep, 2.8 mm felt remaining), 0.35 in total depth, and no rigid core; seven 1.69 in pitches give an 11.83 in tile, a 0.03 in discrepancy with the listed 11.80 in panel width. Muted white-oak and neutral grey-felt colors are sampled from main.jpg; grain is procedural and both axes wrap seamlessly.
